title: Required items in the identification form
goal: Add a unified mark to the required input boxes of the venue application form according to attributes.
summary: The attribute name in square brackets checks whether the element has the attribute. input[required] will select the input box with required.
tasks: Use the attribute selector to select the input with the required attribute.
Set the background of the required input box to #fff9eb and the border color to #ad6822. The contact number input box retains its original style.
hint: If you write required in square brackets, the browser will check whether the attribute exists. Check "Contact number (optional)" after refreshing the preview.
